wish: someone should make a tool that shows sunrise and sunset times
spec:
Computes sunrise, sunset, solar noon, civil dawn/dusk and day length for any latitude, longitude and date, plus a table for the whole month.
Pick a city, tap Use my location, or type coordinates; choose the date and time zone and tap Show times.
Does not look up places by name or guess the time zone from coordinates; everything is calculated offline.
notes: Offline NOAA solar algorithm; times shown in the chosen IANA time zone (device zone by default). Geolocation only on tap.
